ZWE.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is stated only for tax administration, a sector system.

facts.fact: The Zimbabwe Revenue Authority says its 2026-2030 strategy adopts AI-driven analytics to identify non-compliance patterns, forecast risks and monitor compliance, and NewsDay says it is already pursuing a tax collection campaign using AI.

ZWE.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
Only a passing mention of digital skills development for the workforce; no programme stated.
Nothing on digital skills of the public.
